name: Northern Wolf Den
details: A cold, frost-bound lair. Tapping reveals the Dire Wolf Alpha lurking within. Recommended Level: 1-5.

name: Weeping Crystal Gorge
details: A sapphire-encrusted cavern system draped in glowing spider silk. Recommended Level: 11-15.

name: High Crag Cavern
details: A geothermal cavern filled with hot sulfur pools and steam pillars. Recommended Level: 6-10.

name: Ironroots Stronghold
details: An imposing brute-force stone tunnel reinforced by heavy scrap iron gates. Recommended Level: 16-20.

name: Sovereign Dragon Vault
details: The ultimate seat of Fire and Crystal. The legendary Level 30 Crystal Dragon rests here. Recommended Level: 26-30.

name: Ashen Fangs Den
details: A sulfurous den inside volcanic stone folds. Tapping reveals a level 5 Dire Wolf Alpha.
